senses.definition: Any oxide of ytterbium, but especially the colourless solid Yb₂O₃ (ytterbia)
A fluoride compound of potassium with the chemical formula YF₃.
A synthetic mineral used for its special magnetic and optical properties.
A birefringent crystal, typically doped with neodymium and used as a gain medium in solid-state lasers.
An oxide compound of yttrium with the chemical formula Y₂O₃.
